## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b0173e29c98b9047b26d9ae74a6f378343ec5393`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0090-permission-model-v2-concept-convergence.md, docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md + packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts, packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/identity/eval-user.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ai/mcp.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.walled-catalog-tenant-writes-retired.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/sys-user-position.object.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-evaluator.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/app-default-permission-set.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/auto-org-admin-grant.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-scim-*.object.ts (seven), packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.ts, scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json, docs/adr/0095 (rungs), docs/adr/0068 (D2), docs/adr/0105 (D4)

Inputs read: card #24135 body and both comments (claim `6232009241`, os-dev report `6232264546`); ruling `6228728551` on #23960 and the director deltas `6228146260`, `6228658787`; PR #24163 body, file list (2 files, +68/-0) and the net diff against `main` at the head; the 42 check-runs on the head. PR is draft, head repo = base repo, Tier H (`docs/adr/**`).

### ① Derived judgments

**The ruled boundary (items 1, 3, 4) against the amended D12 text.**

- Item 1 is stated exactly, no wider: holder of `organization_admin` / `organization_admin_no_bypass` for one organization and not a platform administrator; creates and removes `sys_user_position` / `sys_user_permission_set` rows for that organization's members; every distributed set (the granted set, or each set the assigned position carries) meets (a) no `objects['*']` `viewAllRecords` / `modifyAllRecords`, (b) no `adminScope`, (c) only `scope: 'org'` capabilities; `admin_full_access`, platform-capability sets, `organization_admin` in both variants and every delegated set outside; status by membership grade only (`auto-org-admin-grant.ts`). Strict containment and the anchors unchanged. The three kinds (tenant-level / organization-level / delegated) are the ones delta 4 named. The pre-existing D12 text is not rewritten; status-line entry plus dated blockquote is the ADR's own convention (D11's 2026-10-14 note is the precedent).
- Item 3 is stated exactly: no spec key; the v18 entry's `replacement` text (`18.walled-catalog-tenant-writes-retired.ts:23`-`:29`, "an organization's administrators assign it to their own members through `sys_user_position` and `sys_user_permission_set`") stands and the note says it becomes true. `Clause-②: no` on the PR.
- Item 4 is cited but applied wrongly — see the D10 ceilings below. The text says the fallback denylist "names no set at this date". It must name three.

**The six "precisions" of the PR body.**

1. Tenant-level = the platform administrator alone, with the ADR-0095 `TENANT_ADMIN` name clash called out — right. ADR-0095 `:183`-`:184` ranks `PLATFORM_ADMIN` above `TENANT_ADMIN`; `eval-user.zod.ts` names `organization_admin` as the `TENANT_ADMIN` rung's source; ADR-0068 D2 maps `platform_admin` to the unscoped `admin_full_access` grant. A vocabulary fix, neither wider nor narrower than delta 4's 「租户级(平台管理员)」.
2. Condition (c) fail-closed on an undeclared scope — right and narrowing. `CapabilityDeclarationSchema.scope` is `z.enum(['platform','org']).default('platform')` (`capabilities.ts:189`); all 10 `PLATFORM_CAPABILITIES` rows carry `scope` (5 `platform`: `manage_users`, `manage_metadata`, `manage_platform_settings`, `setup.access`, `studio.access`; 5 `org`: `manage_org_users`, `setup.write`, `manage_sharing`, `view_all_audit_log`, `manage_mailboxes`); a name no declaration carries is not `org`.
3. "Each set a position carries" includes the position-name fold — right and narrowing. `security-plugin.ts:6542` requests `[...positions, ...explicitPermissionSets]`, so a held position also resolves the set of its own name. Verified in the same read: the gate's `setsBoundToPosition` (`delegated-admin-gate.ts:1086`-`:1099`) reads only `definition.permissionSets` and does not see that set — the ADR text now obliges #24136's third branch to count it (acceptance note 1 is true).
4. Both organization-administrator variants outside by name — right and narrowing. `deriveWallLessOrgAdmin` (`default-permission-sets.ts:1486`) drops only the two superuser bits and carries `systemPermissions: ['manage_org_users','setup.access','setup.write','manage_mailboxes']` over, so the variant is outside by (c) today (`setup.access` is `platform`) and by name whatever a scope later becomes — the by-name exclusion is what "conferred by membership grade only" requires.
5. The three D10 agent ceilings inside by the conditions — **wrong as a classification for this boundary.** Mechanically the conditions place them inside (no superuser bit, no `adminScope`, no `systemPermissions`), but the ruling's premise is 「只能分配被组织墙约束的目录项」 and these sets are not wall-bounded on their own. Judged on the code:
   - `mcp_agent_data_read` is `objects: { '*': { allowRead: true } }` with no `rowLevelSecurity` (`default-permission-sets.ts:1427`-`:1435`); `mcp_agent_data_write` adds CRUD bits and `denyWritesOnManagedObjects()` (`:1437`-`:1450`), still no row scope. `mcp.zod.ts:158`-`:160` declares them "pure capability ceilings — NO row-level security. All row/owner/tenant narrowing comes from the delegating user's own sets on the other side of the intersection" (D10 rule 1). Held by a person as a direct grant there is no intersection: sets merge most-permissively, so the ceiling is a floor.
   - `resolveObjectPermission` (`permission-evaluator.ts:149`-`:160`) applies a `'*'` wildcard to every non-private object. The seven SCIM projection objects (`platform-objects/src/identity/sys-scim-*.object.ts`) declare no `access` posture and no `requiredPermissions`, so the wildcard read reaches them.
   - Layer 0 is inert on all seven: `scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json` records `tenantField: null`, `reach: out` for `sys_scim_user`, `sys_scim_subject`, `sys_scim_projection_grant`, `sys_scim_identity_tombstone`, `sys_scim_group`, `sys_scim_group_member`, `sys_scim_connection_binding`; the #20001 header (`default-permission-sets.ts:105`-`:170`) says the same.
   - Layer 1 starts `null` and stays `null` when no policy is collected (`security-plugin.ts:7218`-`:7221`); `collectRLSPolicies` (`:8998`-`:9035`) gathers policies across ALL held sets, so the only thing that bounds a wildcard reader on these tables is another held set's `scimProjectionRowScope` (`_self` / `_none`). That scope is spread into `member_default`, `viewer_readonly` and `organization_admin` (and its derived variant) — not into the ceilings.
   - The human baseline is `member_default` by default and `[]` under `fallbackPermissionSet: null` — "the one escape hatch", a supported deployment option (`app-default-permission-set.ts:40`-`:57`; `security-plugin.ts:1505`-`:1514`). The #20001 header designs for exactly that deployment ("a deployment that composes no platform baseline resolves an org admin's sets without `member_default`").
   - The granting organization administrator itself does NOT hold that read: `denyWritesOnManagedObjects()` gives `organization_admin` an explicit per-object `{ allowRead: true }` entry for every SCIM table, the explicit entry wins over the wildcard (`resolveObjectPermission`), so its `viewAllRecords` bypass does not reach them and the `_self` / `_none` scope applies — deliberately, "no org-admin admission" (`:662`-`:665`).
   - Nothing refuses a person being granted an MCP ceiling: the three names are referenced outside tests only in `default-permission-sets.ts`, `explain-engine.ts` (doc), `mcp.zod.ts` (scope mapping) and the CLI inventory; they resolve by name like any other set through `sys_user_permission_set`.

   Conclusion: on a walled posture (`group` / `isolated`) with `fallbackPermissionSet: null`, a member whom an organization administrator grants `mcp_agent_data_read` or `mcp_agent_data_write` reads every organization's SCIM projection rows — identity-provider records of other tenants — a read the grantor does not hold. That is a real cross-organization read path, and the amended text as written authorizes an organization administrator to open it. Under the default baseline the path is closed by `member_default`'s carve-outs, but the ADR rule is deployment-independent and classifies the set inside categorically, and #24136's gate will enforce the text as written. The dev's acceptance note ("Carrier: none", "not a classification question for this boundary") is refused.

   The instrument: ruling item 4's denylist is the right instrument for the three shipped ceilings, within the ruling and without a box visit — they are a shipped bundle the three conditions mis-settle, because their declared bound is another principal's grants (D10 rule 1), not the organization wall; the PR body's own precision 5 pre-names this instrument. The D12 note's measured paragraph must say the denylist names `mcp_agent_data_read`, `mcp_agent_data_write` and `mcp_agent_restricted` (the last by kind: an agent ceiling is not a person's set), with the reason above, and "names no set at this date" must go. The general class the same reasoning exposes — any authored set carrying a `'*'` read and no row scope on a Layer-0-inert readable object, in a no-baseline deployment — is NOT settled by the three conditions and no shipped-set denylist can settle it; whether the rule takes a fourth condition or states its guarantee as conditional on the platform baseline is a permission-boundary term only the maintainer can add. That question goes back to the maintainer (`needs-user-decision`, carried by the seat) before #24136's gate ships; the ADR text must not decide it silently, and this record does not.
6. Create and remove only — right; ruling item 2's `allowCreate` / `allowDelete` on, `allowEdit` off, restated as the right's shape.

**The shipped-set table against the code** (`default-permission-sets.ts`, eight sets, the roster held equal to `SHIPPED_PERMISSION_SET_NAMES` at `organization-ownership-inventory.ts:215`; no other non-test `PermissionSetSchema.parse(` / `definePermissionSet(` outside `packages/spec`, `packages/qa` and `packages/verify` fixtures):

- `admin_full_access` — (a) no (`ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES`: wildcard with both bits), (b) yes, (c) no (`manage_users`, `manage_metadata`, `manage_platform_settings`, `setup.access`, `studio.access`; it also carries four `org` capabilities, immaterial) — outside. Row right.
- `organization_admin` — (a) no (`:444`-`:450`), (b) yes, (c) no (`setup.access`, `:487`) — outside, also by name. Row right.
- `organization_admin_no_bypass` — (a) yes (derivation drops both bits), (b) yes, (c) no (`setup.access`) — outside, also by name. Row right.
- `member_default` — (a) yes (no `'*'` entry, #5491), (b) yes, (c) yes (no `systemPermissions`) — inside. Row right.
- `viewer_readonly` — (a) yes (`allowRead` only), (b) yes, (c) yes — inside; it carries `scimProjectionRowScope` itself, so it is wall-bounded on its own. Row right.
- `mcp_agent_data_read`, `mcp_agent_data_write`, `mcp_agent_restricted` — the three cells are mechanically right; the verdict column is wrong for this boundary (precision 5).

**Other factual sentences of the new text, checked:** `PlatformCapability.scope` at `capabilities.ts:33` — true; `PermissionSetSchema.adminScope` at `permission.zod.ts:1022` — true; superuser bits are `ObjectPermissionSchema.viewAllRecords` / `modifyAllRecords` (`:485`, `:508`) — true; `isTenantAdmin` is a wildcard `modifyAllRecords` holder reading the walled `organization_admin` as tenant-level and the variant as no administrator (`delegated-admin-gate.ts:256`-`:263`, `:332`) — true; the anchors are refused unconditionally on `sys_user_position` insert/update (`:296`-`:310`) — true; D9 binds anchors by admin confirmation, never a package — true; `reserved_identity_position` at `sys-user-position.object.ts:256` — true, with one wording point: the validation "takes no provenance exemption" and refuses every writer, so "from every non-system writer" under-states it (true as written; tighten if the text is touched). "Assigns any set to anyone" for the tenant-level kind is the `PLATFORM_ADMIN` rung's reach on posture-permitting objects; acceptable. ADR-0131's note states the same three conditions and points at the D12 amendment — consistent with D12's text; it inherits the item-4 correction only by reference, no second edit needed.

### ② Semver level

ADR prose only; two files under `docs/adr/**`; no package source, no `packages/spec` key, no schema, no test, no migration text. `skip-changeset` is the right label and `Clause-②: no` the right declaration. `Check Changeset` is `success` on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Deviation 1 (`check:doc-formula-expressions` first exit 3, rebuilt under the lock, re-run 0): recorded, not a failed measurement — answered.
- Deviation 2 (model-free trailer pair instead of the harness reminder): AGENTS.md `:461` is the rule — right.
- Deviation 3 (no ADR-0131 status-line entry): the claim's file surface named one dated note under D3; ADR-0131 carries dated notes without status entries (`:66`, the inline withdrawal at `:315`) — accepted.
- Deviation 4 (no env value printed): n/a.
- Acceptance note 1 (`setsBoundToPosition` blind to the position-name fold): true on the code; carrier #24136 is right, and the ADR text now makes extending that walk an obligation of #24136's third branch, not an option.
- Acceptance note 2 (`isTenantAdmin` reads the walled set as tenant-level, the variant as none): true; carrier #24136 right — the ADR note records it.
- Acceptance note 3 (`docs/design/permission-model.md` §10 lacks the organization-level kind): carrier #24136 right; docs follow enforcement.
- Acceptance note 4 (D10 ceilings, "Carrier: none"): escalated — see ① precision 5. The shipped instance is closed in this PR by the item-4 denylist; the general class goes to the maintainer as `needs-user-decision` through the seat.
- Gates: 42 check-runs on the head, read 2026-10-17T09:27Z. All `success` or `skipped` by selector (Build Core, Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Temporal Conformance, Packed-tarball smoke, Dogfood shards and Verify CLI, one duplicate-named Check Changeset / Check PR Size / Auto Label); `Test Core (1/6)` `in_progress` at read time; `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, the three claim/closing guards and `Check Documentation Links` `success`. No local run.
- Landing: Tier H; the PR stays draft until the maintainer's approval. This record does not lift it.

**Prescription for the next head:** in the D12 note's measured paragraph, name the three D10 ceilings in the ruling's item-4 denylist with the reason (an agent ceiling's bound is the delegator's grants, not the wall; held by a person it carries no row scope on the Layer-0-inert projection tables), drop "names no set at this date", and move the three from "Inside" to "Outside (denylist)". Keep everything else. The seat files the general-class question for the maintainer in the same act.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-24135-adr-0090-d12-org-admin-boundary`
Reviewed-by: `session_01HSDGREvqxQUt7K7pjHXMyC`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## 维护者速读

### 改了什么

在权限模型 ADR-0090 的 D12(管理权限)里加了一条带日期的修订,并在 ADR-0131 D3 下加了一行注记。纯文字:不改代码,不加 spec 键。

修订把管理者分成三类:
- 租户级(平台管理员);
- 组织级(组织的 owner / admin,自动获得组织管理员权限集);
- 委托级(带 `adminScope` 的人)。

组织级管理员可以给**本组织成员**增加或移除岗位与权限集,但只限「被组织墙约束住」的集,即同时满足三条:
- 不带通配超级用户位;
- 不带 `adminScope`;
- 所含能力全部是组织级。

`admin_full_access`、平台级集、组织管理员集本身(两个变体)和任何委托集都不能分。组织管理员身份只能由成员资格(owner / admin)获得,不能靠分配复制。

另外,三个给 AI 代理用的 MCP 上限权限集列入您裁决第 4 条预留的黑名单,组织管理员不能把它们分给人。

### 为什么改

这是您 10 月 17 日对 #23960 裁决 B(「同意」)的第一步。ADR-0131 D3 承诺「组织的管理员给本组织成员分配」,但代码为了防止组织管理员给自己绑 `admin_full_access` 越过组织墙,把两张分配表设成了只读。缺的正是「组织管理员能分配哪些」这条边界。边界先写进 ADR,代码卡 #24136 才能照着实现。
